commentaire: The actual winner of stage 9, Carlos LOPEZ, tested positive for EPO after stage 9. Therefore he was diqualified from stage 9 and all further stages of the Vuelta a Guatemala. The actual leader after stage 9 and number 5 in today's stage, Yeisson DELGADO, and the number 2 in today's stage, Lizandro Roberto AJCU, both tested positive for EPO after stage 7. Therefore they were disqualified from stage 7 and all further stages of the Vuelta a Guatemala.
titre: Vuelta a Guatemala, Stage 9 : San Pedro San Marcos - Huehuetenango (140 km)
